sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting comfortably at the top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The league leaders arrive in excellent form, unbeaten in their last five matches (W-D-W-W-W), and face an Alsager side struggling near the foot of the division with just 4 points from 10 games. This should be a straightforward opportunity for Sandbach to extend their advantage and maintain their undefeated streak.
divisionWide: The title chase remains competitive with second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) facing a tricky away trip to Dawley Town on Saturday. Meanwhile, third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in what could be a closely contested affair between two strong sides. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth with 19 points, travel to face Wednesfield Community in a fixture that could have mid-table implications. Elsewhere, Bilston Town (fifth) entertain Foley Meir, while Barnton visit Shawbury United in matches between sides in the middle-to-lower reaches. At the bottom, Widnes Town continue their struggle with a visit to Brereton Social, and the division's other struggling sides contest the remaining fixtures: Telford Town away at Cheadle Heath Nomads, New Mills host Market Drayton Town, and Crewe travel to face Allscott Heath. These lower-table clashes will be crucial for teams fighting to avoid the drop.
